tickets_addressed: B04-01 (P1, verified): the newly-reached endpoint of a BUILD_ROAD action is now determined from pre-action connectivity (board.connected_components), not from tuple position. v002's `_, far = act.value` assumed edges are given in (near, far) order; Board.buildable_edges actually returns (n1, n2) with n1 < n2, an arbitrary sort order. The review's constructed fixture (new port at the lower-numbered endpoint, already-connected higher-numbered endpoint) is now scored correctly.

B04-02 (P1, verified): _justified_port_value no longer grants any bonus at zero specialized production (v002 granted scale*0.1 even at exactly zero); the generic 3:1 port case now requires real two-resource-equivalent surplus (>= 2*PROBA_6) instead of merely two nonzero production entries; PROBA_6 is now the exact fraction 5/36 instead of the rounded decimal 0.1389, which was slightly larger than 5/36 and so failed the review's exact-threshold probe.
M2-C01 (P1): same per-candidate exception handling and diagnostic counters as B03 v003 -- a failing candidate no longer discards every already-scored action for the turn.
M2-C02 (P1): same explicit immediate-own-win short-circuit as B03 v003, bypassing base_fn and the port bonus entirely rather than relying on a bonus-scale argument.
